messages.subject: High difference between LAVAAN & AMOS ?
parts:
Hello,

I am writing this message to inform you that I have processed an analysis with LAVAAN after having used AMOS (SPSS).

I see that my models are similar (Chi2, RMSEA, weights ...) (I used the same parameters), however I found a big difference between AMOS and LAVAAN on indicator covariance between two latent variables (.53 vs .002).

How can this be explained? LAVAAN bug or inaccuracy in AMOS?

Best regards,
Arnaud
